description: Restore a site to a previous version (undo). Pass the manage token and the version number from list_versions. Restores that version's content to the live URL and resets the expiry timer. Returns structuredContent { status, url, restored_from, updated, url_ready_in_seconds }. Errors: version_not_found (no such version) | no_versions (nothing to roll back to) | invalid_token.

version.description: The version to restore, from list_versions.

name: rollback_website
title: Roll back website
